assertions.assertion: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring was performed using CPT 93229
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Diagnosis code I48.0 is associated with the patient
Diagnosis code G45.9 is associated with the patient
Diagnosis code Z86.73 is associated with the patient
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptoms to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management
The clinical indication note documents the medical necessity of the service
The payer denied the claim under Reason Code CO-197
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
The appeal submits the clinical indication note as supporting documentation to establish that the service was consistent with plan guidelines and medical necessity
